title: Songkhla Marathon 2026 Review: What the 27th Edition Was Like
meta_description: Songkhla Marathon 2026 review: 9,000+ runners from 32 countries over 22-23 August, a 3am marathon start at Tinsulanonda Stadium, World Athletics label.
dek: Southern Thailand's oldest marathon, by the organiser's account, held its 27th edition over 22 and 23 August 2026 from Tinsulanonda Stadium. Here is what it was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: The Songkhla Marathon has a long history in southern Thailand, and the 27th edition drew more than 9,000 runners from 32 countries over 22 and 23 August 2026 [1]. It carries a World Athletics road race label [1][2] and ran four categories from Tinsulanonda Stadium, with the marathon off at 3am [1]. The routes passed Songkhla's main sights [1]. If you want an established provincial marathon in Thailand with a big field and an early, cooler start, it is a sound choice. The reporting comes from state media and the organiser, so it tells you more about scale than about the running experience.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition in Numbers
paragraphs: The 27th Songkhla International Marathon was run over the weekend of 22 and 23 August 2026 at Tinsulanonda Stadium in Mueang Songkhla, and drew more than 9,000 runners from 32 countries [1].

There were four categories. The 5 km fun run on Saturday 22 August had 1,200 participants [1]. On Sunday, the marathon started at 3am with 2,000 runners, the half marathon at 4am with 2,500, and the 10 km at 4.45am with 3,300 [1].

sections.heading: The Race and Its Label
paragraphs: The race was held under a World Athletics road race label and is listed on the World Athletics competition calendar [1]. The organiser says the label was first awarded in 2023 [2].

The deputy governor of Songkhla started the marathon, and provincial officials started the half marathon and 10 km [1]. The routes passed through the province's main tourist sights and scenic areas [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a marathon in southern Thailand with history, a big field and a World Athletics label, yes. The organiser calls it the first marathon in the South [2], and 27 editions show in its scale.
The 3am start is the practical detail to plan around. It keeps most of the marathon out of the sun, but it means an early night and an even earlier alarm.
This review is compiled from state-media reporting and the organiser's published information. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Songkhla Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: More than 9,000 runners from 32 countries took part in the 27th edition on 22 and 23 August 2026: 2,000 in the marathon, 2,500 in the half marathon, 3,300 in the 10 km and 1,200 in the 5 km fun run, according to NBT World.

faqs.question: What time does the Songkhla Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Early. In 2026 the marathon started at 3am on Sunday 23 August, the half marathon at 4am and the 10 km at 4.45am, all from Tinsulanonda Stadium. The 5 km fun run was held the day before.

faqs.question: Is the Songkhla Marathon a World Athletics race?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is run under a World Athletics road race label, first awarded in 2023 according to the organiser, and it is listed on the official World Athletics competition calendar. The organiser calls it the first marathon in southern Thailand.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the 27th edition, run on 22-23 August 2026. Replaces a pre-race preview. The main source is a post by Thailand's state broadcaster NBT World. No rating: nothing here is participant evidence.
